evidence_guided_agent.implementation: One capable Agent with the admitted evidence and existing tools; a special multi-agent architecture is not required.

route: Executable program for initial feasibility; direct row submission remains a valid later implementation route.
same_information: same admitted packet across independent constructions within a task
same broad scientific use and tool permissions

model_budget.record_exact_model_identifier_before_lau: Record the available model/settings metadata and disclose unavailable backend identity; no invented precision.
model_budget.token_and_wall_time_metering: not provided by current harness; record caller metadata if available, otherwise mark unavailable
model_budget.interpretation: Record actual resources where available. Strict equal-token cost is not claimed and a matched competitor is not required.

selection: Prespecify source-only candidate selection; evaluate every independent final construction, not best-of-two. Initial and final remain available for later revision attribution.
statistical_arm: Optional contextual comparison; specification is no longer a feasibility launch gate.
prepared_inputs: curated numeric evidence with item restrictions
common point estimator with invented tests
readiness_not_yet_claimed: record available model and resource metadata
NHANES variance adapter before reference inference
retrieval_track: Separate later experiment, because curated shared packets isolate evidence use rather than autonomous search
future_ablation: Only for an explicit additional mechanism or superiority claim; not needed to establish initial data-method feasibility.
prohibited: treating residual seeds or correlated endpoints as independent tasks
primary_question: Can evidence-guided Agent-generated data support useful unprovided scientific analyses in the target data?
ordinary_agent_role: Valid method implementation; superiority over it is not a required claim.

supersedes.scope: Primary claim, required arms, run count and launch gates; historical v1 preserved.

primary_reference: Same prespecified analyses on the reserved real outcomes; no outcome feedback to construction.
user_scope_priority: Method feasibility and analytical reuse first; framework superiority is optional.
